instruction: packaging.metadata validates Description-Content-Type, but a malformed value can leak an unrelated exception (for example IndexError for 'text/plain; x*') or be silently accepted despite header defects (for example 'text/plain; charset="unterminated' or 'text/plain; a}b'). Report such values as InvalidMetadata for the 'description-content-type' field, whose message includes the repr of the value and the phrase 'is not a valid content type', so that Metadata.from_email() reports exactly one InvalidMetadata for that field in its ExceptionGroup. Keep the existing 'must be one of ...' error for well-formed but unsupported content types (for example application/octet-stream, which must still raise InvalidMetadata when the attribute is read). Add tests.
instruction_source: written from the fix commit message, linked issue and hidden tests; describes behavior, not the change
